Join us for an awe-inspiring adventure with captivating shows and special musical events that ignite curiosity and wonder for all ages. services.name: Library Pass Program
services.desc: Did you know you can visit the Reading Public Museum for free with our library pass program? Local libraries throughout the area offer Museum admission passes, making it easy and affordable to explore our exhibits, programs, and family-friendly experiences. Are you a member of your local library? You can use your library card to check out more than just books and check out a day pass to The Museum. This pass is valid for two adults and four children and grants you free admission to The Museum and $1 off of Neag Planetarium tickets.
